description: This file defines a Python class `SentenceAggregator` that extends `FrameProcessor` to process frames, specifically accumulating text frames into complete sentences based on end-of-sentence detection. It provides functionality for sentence-level aggregation in a text processing pipeline, utilizing imported modules for frame definitions and string matching.

classes.name: SentenceAggregator
classes.description: Aggregates text frames into complete sentences by accumulating incoming text until a sentence-ending pattern is detected, then outputs the complete sentence.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the SentenceAggregator instance and sets up internal state for accumulating text frames.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes incoming frames to accumulate text into complete sentences, pushing frames downstream when a sentence is complete or when an EndFrame is encountered.
